title: Banned in Boston by Illinois Jacquet CD, 1989 Portrait Records
descriptionText: "Banned in Boston" is a jazz CD released by Illinois Jacquet in May 1989 under the Portrait record label. The album features bebop style music with a run time of 35 minutes. The title "Banned in Boston" suggests that the album may contain music that was controversial or not well-received in Boston, possibly due to its avant-garde or experimental nature. Fans of bebop and jazz music from the late 20th century may find this album to be a unique addition to their collection, showcasing Jacquet's talent and innovation in the genre.
